name: Progress M-27M
about: Progress M-27M (2015-024A), a crewed vehicle (Progress MM), launched 2015 Apr 28. One orbit from GCAT's satcat (shape and inclination; orientation estimated), then how that phase ended (R).

pieces.why: GCAT gives the orbit's shape and inclination, not its orientation or where along it the craft was; the orbit is GCAT's at its epoch (2015 Apr 30), held fixed
